note: Scripted 'agent' applying least privilege, SHA pinning and pull_request.

actions.content:
name: release
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    tags: ["v*"]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@89abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef # v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - run: python -m pip install build && python -m build
